messages:
Priya K: heads-up — customer A ran the private export agent in their VPC and hits our metrics endpoint but the firewall drops egress to prometheus.ingest.redwood.internal:443. They asked for guidance on allowed CIDR and KMS hooks.

Alex M: hmm. are they using the daemonset or standalone sidecar agent?

Priya K: daemonset. node-level egress only. They want to avoid opening broad ranges.

Marco R: we should support an explicit proxy configuration in the agent (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY) + a small whitelist for collector IPs. That avoids per-customer CIDR lists.

Jess L: agree on proxy, but audit logs + KMS requests still go to our control plane in the customer account. Need to coordinate KMS usage — they want CMEK and an audit-log hook so keys are rotated locally.

Priya K: exactly — they require that audit logs (S3 events) reference a KMS key in their account and we sign with a temporary role. Current flow assumes a central key.

Alex M: internal API debate: should the agent push metrics to our collector (push) or expose a local scrape endpoint and let our collector pull in via an approved egress tunnel? Customer network teams care about inbound rules.

Marco R: pull requires us to open inbound from our collector to the VPC — not acceptable for many. Push is simpler: agent initiates outbound TLS to our ingest endpoint.

Jess L: push also gives us better batching and auth control. But need to mitigate quota spikes — quotas per-customer and per-API-key enforced at the edge.

Nina C: on console side: for dashboards we need two new dims: "export_mode" (push|pull), and "agent_kms_key" (masked id), plus a boolean "audit_hook_enabled". We'll show them in Private -> Telemetry rules.

Priya K: can we add tenant_id and cluster_name tags as well? ops teams want to slice latency and bytes by cluster.

Alex M: yes, agent can inject tenant_id and cluster_name (kubectl config or env), but must be authenticated and signed. Don't leak tenant_id in public logs — mask on console when user is not an admin.

Marco R: firewall snippet that I tested locally — outbound allow only to collector fqdn over 443 using TLS SNI is enough. e.g.:
```
# iptables-like pseudo
ALLOW OUT tcp to prometheus.ingest.redwood.internal:443
# or allow to proxy host: 10.0.2.5:3128 if customer provides proxy
```

Jess L: about KMS — we need a short-lived role assumption flow. Proposed: agent uses STS:AssumeRole with external ID, gets creds, calls KMS:Encrypt with customer CMK ARN. We store only ciphertext and never the plaintext key. auditsvc can log the CMK ARN usage.

auditsvc: audit entry generated when export starts, example: 
"agent_export_start tenant=acct-123 cluster=eu-prod export_mode=push kms=arn:aws:kms:..."

Priya K: security note — we must ensure metrics payloads never include PII. Add a redact step in the agent by default, opt-in raw metrics.

Alex M: rollout UX: add an enable toggle in Console -> Private Export with a staged rollout: default off, can enable per-namespace, with a required checklist (KMS configured, proxy/egress validated). We should add an automated preflight check that runs a short TLS handshake from within the agent to our collector and reports success/failure.

Nina C: console mockups incoming — I'll add the dims and the preflight status panel. Need backend flags from API team.

Priya K: API contract — agent v2 will POST to /v1/private-metrics with headers: X-Tenant-ID, X-Cluster, X-Agent-Version, Authorization: Bearer <token>. Body gzipped JSON array. We need to finalize headers and quota semantics.

Alex M: QPS/quota model: tokens are rate-limited per-tenant; support burst up to 5x baseline with refill window tied to contract. Also add per-API-key byte quotas. Track usage for billing and alerting.

Jess L: make sure metric samples are timestamped by agent (client_time) and we validate monotonically per-stream to prevent replay.

Marco R: action items: 1) Marco -> prototype proxy + SNI-only firewall doc (due Tue). 2) Priya -> KMS assume-role flow doc with examples (due Wed). 3) Nina -> console mock + dims (due Thu). 4) Alex -> quota and header spec PR (due Fri). 5) Jess -> redact defaults + telemetry schema (due Fri).

Priya K: I'll also draft a short runbook for customer network teams describing minimal egress rules and proxy options.

Ops Bot: Reminder: runbook-task created #RB-452, owners assigned: Marco, Priya, Nina, Alex, Jess. SLA 5d.

Nina C: quick question — do we want agent to support KMS offline envelope encryption (agent encrypts locally) or server-side envelope?

Jess L: prefer envelope encryption locally with CMK encrypt so we never see plaintext. But implement both: local-encrypt by default, server-side available for low-compliance customers.

Alex M: final note: add telemetry tag for "export_version" so we can track adoption of v2 versus legacy. We'll need a migration plan for customers on old agent.

Priya K: thanks all. I'll upload the initial docs to the eng-platform drive and ping the customer A team with preliminary guidance.

Marco R: thanks — I'll start the firewall doc and paste links here when ready.

Jess L: thanks. closing thread once the PRs land. :thumbsup:
